content:
Sylvie's initial monthly salary is $600, so her initial annual salary is \(600 \times 12 = \$7,200\). The company increases salaries by 10% of the initial salary each year after five years of service. 10% of the initial annual salary is \(0.10 \times 7,200 = \$720\). Sylvie just completed 5 years last December, so she is now eligible for annual raises. After three more years of service, she will have received three raises. Her annual salary will be:
\[
7,200 + 3 \times 720 = 7,200 + 2,160 = \$9,360.
\]

Answer: $9,360
